title: Ising selector machine by Kerr parametric oscillators
summary: Ising machines are physical platforms designed to minimize the energy of classical Ising Hamiltonians, yet accessing specific excited states remains an open challenge of both fundamental and practical relevance. In this letter we show that a network of Kerr parametric oscillators (KPOs) naturally implements an Ising selector machine. By tuning the frequency detuning between the parametric pump and the oscillator resonances, the system can be steered to converge close to the ground state, the highest-energy configuration, or targeted intermediate excited states.
